architecture_name: FP-0002 Shared Reviews Include (Hybrid E / Options C primary)

source_of_truth.legacy_page_repeater: group_fp02_page_reviews reviews_items — defer; optional override in later wave
source_of_truth.demo_fallback: Static V9 card set in theme helper (same content as current home/reviews.php)

admin_screen.implementation_note: Either new field group tab on same options page or dedicated options sub-page fp02-site-settings-reviews — prefer sub-page only if field count grows

precedence: If reviews_enabled is false → hide entire reviews section on all contexts
Else if reviews_items has visible rows → render from options
Else → render static V9 demo fallback cards (current hardcoded set)
Future CPT hook inserts between options and static when implemented
fallback_behavior.demo_policy: Static fallback treated as DEMO; options-seeded rows require operator seed charter in D9-S

home_integration.heading_source: reviews_section_heading option, then home_reviews_heading ACF, then static

partials: template-parts/reviews/archive-list.php → full list from same helper, no limit

frontend.no_reviews_behavior: If disabled → section omitted; if enabled but empty → static demo fallback until operator seeds or disables

home_reviews_teaser_disposition.db_meta: Orphan meta may remain; no destructive DB cleanup in D9-R
home_reviews_teaser_disposition.home_reviews_heading: Keep on Home for now OR migrate to options in D9-R (prefer migrate heading to options for single ownership)

migration_to_production.git: ACF JSON group_fp02_site_options_reviews.json committed in D9-R
migration_to_production.values: D9-S controlled options seed from V9 static (operator-approved); export via ACF/tools
migration_to_production.runtime: D9-R bounded delivery: theme helpers + partial + ACF JSON sync
migration_to_production.rollback: DB checkpoint before options seed; revert theme + hide group

content_policy.demo: Static V9 testimonials = DEMO_ONLY until operator replaces via options seed
content_policy.approved: Options rows edited by operator post D9-S/U
content_policy.legal: D9-U optional native content / testimonial authenticity review before production
